messages:
jem: Cutting RC rc-2026-03-22a from main. Artifacts: gcr.io/redwood/serving:rc-2026-03-22a. Can QA start smoke?
ranjit: Ack. Kicking off smoke job now. Ping when pinned.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rc-2026-03-22a artifact verification passed (sha: abc1234).
maria: Rolling a pin in infra. /pin rc-2026-03-22a -> pinned to candidate slot. ETA ~30s
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin applied to candidate. Canary slot reserved in us-west1.
sara: Running quick end-to-end: chat, embeddings, and kv-warm. Will report within 10m.
ranjit: Thermostat: increase kv-warm concurrency to 4 for smoke. cmd: `kc scale --replicas=4`
maria: Release notes drafted in PR #1245: 'perf fixes, routing fallback, mem kernel update'. Mike, want to check?
mike: Looks fine. Add note about quantization toggle for Dedicated customers. :thumbsup: 
sara: Smoke results: chat ok, embeddings slight latency bump (~50ms). No errors. Logs: ```WARN kv-cache miss 2%```
jem: Latency bump likely due to batch size defaults. Ranjit can we run a quick hotfix to batching config in candidate?
ranjit: I'll push a config tweak to rc-config with smaller max_batch for chat route. Deploying canary to 5% of candidate traffic.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for rc-2026-03-22a (canary=5%). Monitoring metrics: latency, p99, errors.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Telemetry gate OK. No regressions on p99 for 5m.
jem: If canary holds for 15m, promote to prod. Anyone object?
mike: No objections.
maria: Promoting window is open (change window 22:00-04:00 UTC). Proceed when green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled in 10m. Rollback command: `/rollback rc-2026-03-22a --reason <desc>`
jem: Promote now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion started. Steps: pin -> canary -> shift 25% -> 50% -> 100%.
sara: Watching metrics. Noting a small spike in cpu on liveness tests at 50%.
ranjit: Scaling GPU pool by +1 node to absorb burst. scale: `infra scale-gpu --add 1`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion completed to prod. All routes 100% on rc-2026-03-22a.
jem: Thanks team. I'll open formal promo note in release notes PR and tag release.
